728-2464-3249-3621.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-3249-3621.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3249-3621.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

3703-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3703-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

620-2111-2829.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1703-2921-4984.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Academy Researchers
When Academy Researchers dies, Fool's Demise first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Academy Researchers enters, it triggers, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4050-4186-5662--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

2364-4574-4659-5283-6842.notablePrerequisites: There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
2364-4574-4659-5283-6842.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Inexorable Tide triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mana Vault, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mana Vault from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Mana Vault.
Repeat.

1394-2060-4772-5231-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doubling Season.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doubling Season.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

3110-3532-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4452-5231-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.
4452-5231-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2173-4050-5010-5708.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

2061-4377-6927.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Damage Control Crew.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4423-4872-5967-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
4423-4872-5967-6886.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

339-677-955-2438.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1445-2034-4871-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2034-4871-5632.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

372-2239-2955.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Ardent Elementalist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
372-2239-2955.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

678-4659-4766.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a nontoken artifact creature you control.
678-4659-4766.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

997-4089-5011.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

678-1636-2034.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C}.
You have at least one creature card in hand.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the creature card minus {C}{C}.
678-1636-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the creature can be cast using {C} or less, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Cast the creature card by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1068-1367.manaNeeded: {10}{U}{U} your first turn, with {5}{U}{U} available each other turn
1068-1367.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Nexus of Fate during your draw step.
Repeat from step 3.

656-724-1636-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
656-724-1636-5220.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ugin's Conjurant on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Hidetsugu's second ability by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, exiling Ugin's Conjurant from the top of your library and allowing you cast it this turn.
Repeat.

230-2252-3263-4659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
230-2252-3263-4659.description:
Activate Necrogenesis by paying {2}, exling a creature card from an opponent's graveyard and creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {2}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {2} and putting a card from an opponent's exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {2}.
Repeat.

3063-3261.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least 9 other lands.
At least 10 total Gates with different names in your library and/or on the battlefield.
3063-3261.description:
Cast Scapeshift, sacrificing 9 lands and searching your library for nine gates minus the number of gates already on the battlefield under your control and putting them onto the battlefield.
Activate Maze's End, searching your library for a tenth gate and putting it onto the battlefield, winning you the game.

126-2825-4406.notablePrerequisites: Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
126-2825-4406.description:
Pay {3} and tap Elite Arcanist to cast Chance for Glory.
On the next turn pay {3} and tap Elite Arcanist to cast Chance for Glory in response to the lose the game trigger use Obeka, Brute Chronologist to end the turn.
Repeat.

1315-2882-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
1315-2882-4675-4694.description:
Cast Zuran Orb by paying {0}.
Zuran Orb enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Zuran Orb from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
